verdict.rationale: LangGraph docs show a local/dev path (LangGraph CLI running the Agent Server locally, in-memory or dev checkpointers) distinct from a production database-backed checkpointer, which implies a way to iterate locally without touching production data, but there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' or test-data-isolation feature documented. missing for 10: no dedicated sandbox/staging environment concept, no explicit guidance on isolating test data from production, no independent confirmation that local runs are safely isolated from production stores.
